headline: Traicionan investigación a Alan García y éste se limpieza
content: El congresista Víctor García Belaunde (APP) justifica que se investigue a Alan García por el Caso Lava Jato, porque en la Comisión Congresal que vio el tema nunca se investigaron los presuntos vínculos entre el expresidente y las coimas que Odebrecht entregó según él.

headline: Paul Reyes correpondencial
content: Tres muertos y cinco heridos dejó ayer un fatal accidente automotor a la altura del kilómetro 8 de la carretera que une a Huaral y Lima. El choque frontai causó severos destrozos a los vehículos involucrados. Las autoridades sospechan que el conductor del último vehículo pudo haber estado ebrio.

headline: Problemas de salud mental aflijan a la población
content: Durante el año 2016 aproximadamente 3780 personas buscaron atención médica en Hospitales de la Región de Huancavelica por problemas de salud mental. Además, se reportaron casos significativos de ansiedad y alcoholismo dentro de la comunidad local.

headline: Detienen monja por abuso a niños
content: Una religiosa conocida como Kumiko Kosaka ha sido arrestada en Argentina después de ser señalada en un grave incidente de abuso sexual hacia menores en un centro educativo para sordomudos.

headline: Retoman dialogos de Paz con el ELN
content: Juan Restrepo, representante colombiano en las negociaciones de paz con el Ejército de Liberación Nacional (ELN), afirmó que ambas partes retomaran las conversaciones el próximo 16 de mayo.

headline: Manifiestantes destruyen estatua de Hugo Chávez
content: Ciudadanos manifestándose en Venezuela demolieron una estatua erigida en honor al expresidente Hugo Cháveze en respuesta a acciones consideradas represivas por parte del actual régimen liderado por Nicolás Maduro.

headline: Financista de banda ‘Los Malditos’ capturado
content: Wilder Rafael Arroyo Benites, apodado Rafa, fue detenido mientras fungía como principal financista de la organización criminal Los Malditos de Chicago II, siendo responsable también de gestionar fondos obtenidos ilegalmente mediante diversos medios criminales.

headline: Ministerio del Interior presenta avances en combate al narcotráfico
content: Según información oficial, más de veinte propiedades asociadas a la venta de sustancias prohibidas fueron confiscadas en Trujillo, evidenciando así progreso notable en la estrategia anti-drogas implementada por el Ministerio del Interior.

headline: Medics and Nurses Infected With Dengue in Piura
content: The advance of dengue fever in the Piura region continues relentlessly. Not only does the number of infected residents increase, but also the count of medical personnel affected rises, impacting healthcare services provided to sick locals.  According to figures obtained by the Front Broadening Movements leader, Andrés Cevallos, approximately 600 specialists have been impacted in the Piura region up until now. Dr. Cesar Morán Pastor, Director of the Health Directorate (DIRESA) of Piura, stated technically this situation should not affect care because hours are still being met, though he acknowledged service quality has indeed suffered.

headline: Guard Collects Toll Fee in SMP
content: In San Martin de Porres district, a security guard was caught closing public road gates and collecting toll fees from vehicles passing through the intersection of Av. Caquetá and Virgen María street. Three young men pooled together nearly 2150 Euros to purchase a large batch of beer weighing over half a ton which had to be transported using a truck due to its weight.

headline: Grandfather Dies Attempting Record Climb Up Mount Everest
content: An elderly Nepali climber passed away while attempting to reclaim his record as the oldest person ever to scale Mount Everest. Min Bahadur Shrestha died during his climb after previously setting records at age 76 and again at 79 before losing the title last year.

headline: Friends Watch Over Departed Friend During Poker Game
content: Henry Rosario, known affectionately as Kinky, who succumbed to severe heart conditions, left behind friends who chose to honor him uniquely—by watching over him during a poker game, reflecting their shared passion.

headline: First Cat Space Traveler Returns Safely From Mission
content: France’s first cat astronaut named Félicette returned safely from space mission back in 1963, marking a significant milestone in animal participation in space exploration.

headline: Healthcare Workers Struggle Amid Rising Dengue Cases
content: With increasing cases of dengue affecting both patients and health workers alike, there remains concern about how these challenges impact overall patient care within hospitals like Hospital de la Amistad Peru-Korea in Santa Rosa, where around 100 staff members were reported ill.

headline: Surveillance Captures Gang Members Breaking Into Homes
content: Three burglars identified as part of the notorious gang ‘the south dads’ were apprehended breaking into homes near City of God market in San Juan de Miraflores. They attempted to poison pets belonging to victims, leading to police intervention based on neighborhood alerts.

headline: Prostitute Trafficking Suspect Arrested After Colombian Woman Reports Abuse
content: Following reports from a deceived Colombian woman seeking employment opportunities abroad, suspect Fernando Ziga Fernandez was detained under charges related to human trafficking and forced prostitution activities conducted out of his residence in San Miguel.

headline: Paramilitary Killings Continue Despite Peace Agreements
content: Despite peace agreements between government forces and rebel groups such as FARC, civilian casualties continue unabated according to Daniel Matthews Melino whose daughter became another victim amidst ongoing violence in regions close to Cali, Colombia.

headline: Police Shootout Leaves One Dead in Callao
content: During a law enforcement operation targeting drug traffickers led by Freddy Emanuel Marigorda Pajuelo alias Paco Marigorda, gunfire ensued resulting in fatalities including Marigorda himself along with injuries sustained by three accomplices.

headline: Two Transvestites Caught Robbing Tourists in Central District
content: Known locally as transvestites of the center, two individuals were arrested following accusations of stealing cell phones and money from tourists entering accommodations located in Miraflores.

headline: Recycler Murdered By Teenager For Stealing Scrap Metal
content: Roger Joaquín Rivera Alcocer, nicknamed Boquito,’ admitted killing a fellow scrap metal collector whom he accused repeatedly of theft against his mother’s business operations, ultimately resorting to fatal aggression amid escalating confrontations.

headline: Former Defense Minister Prepares Wedding Details
content: Amid past controversies involving former minister Mariano Gonzalez, preparations proceed for his marriage ceremony with his long-time partner, showcasing enduring love despite previous scandals.

headline: Displaced Families Still Living Under Makeshift Conditions Post-Natural Disaster
content: Over fifty days since initial disaster response efforts began, families displaced by flooding remain living in temporary shelters lacking basic amenities, relying heavily on community support dwindling over time.

headline: Marijuana Legalization Protest Blocked by Police Force
content: Authorities prevented demonstrators advocating for marijuana legalization from marching towards Plaza Washington, citing lack of official permits even as participants claimed otherwise.
